'''Cat on Hot Sand''' is a [[sword form]]. Aside from the name, nothing is known about the actual movement.

==In practice==
[[Rand al'Thor]] flowed through this form while attacking [[Trolloc]]s after stealing back the [[Horn of Valere]] from [[Padan Fain]].{{ref/book|2|19}} [[Gawyn Trakand]] moved through this form as [[Marlesh]] tried to use [[Hummingbird Kisses the Honeyrose]] during a bout involving Gawyn against Marlesh and [[Sleete]].{{ref/book|12|13}} Gawyn also used this form against a [[Bloodknife]] who was trying to kill [[Egwene al'Vere]].{{ref/book|13|37}}
